items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1974-03-28
items.q: Dewdrop brought Donna Washington, all the people, big people there with the Dewdrop.

ctx.x: Different place like that. What was a Dewdrop like?

Well, Dewdrop, you know, brought plenty of tracks in here. You know, like Big Joe Turner, all those kind of bars. Yeah, Dewdrop brought Donna Washington, all the people, big people there with the Dewdrop.
Yeah, they had nice paintings and everything. Remember I told you about that, huh? No. I think Johnny Don Ellis did the paintings.
